evals.prompt:
SAQ 연습 문제 답안이야. 채점해줘.

문제:
(a) Identify ONE way the Columbian Exchange affected the Americas in the period 1450–1750.
(b) Describe ONE way the Atlantic slave trade affected African societies in the period 1450–1750.
(c) Explain ONE reason European states established maritime empires in the period 1450–1750.

답안:
(a) Smallpox and other diseases brought by Europeans killed a large part of the Native American population.
(b) It affected the Kingdom of Dahomey.
(c) European states wanted to get spices and other Asian goods directly instead of paying high prices to Ottoman and Venetian middlemen, so Portugal and Spain sponsored voyages to find sea routes, and these voyages led to trading posts and colonies.
evals.expected_output: 2/3. (a) 1 — accurate identification. (b) 0 — names an isolated term (Dahomey) without describing how African societies were affected. (c) 1 — explains a reason with a causal link (bypass middlemen → sponsored voyages → trading posts/colonies).
assertions: Part (b) earns 0 points because it names an isolated term without describing an effect
